MERGE INTO CHB_INTERF_ERRODATA CII USING (
SELECT #{item.datauuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATAUUID, #{item.dataid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATAID, #{item.interfType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} INTERF_TYPE, #{item.fireName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FIRE_NAME, #{item.orgData,jdbcType=CLOB} ORG_DATA, #{item.errMsg,jdbcType=CLOB} ERR_MSG, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WORKFLOW_ID, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORG_CODE, #{item.deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DEPT_CODE FROM DUAL
) TEMP
ON(CII.DATAID = TEMP.DATAID)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.INTERF_TYPE = TEMP.INTERF_TYPE,CII.FIRE_NAME = TEMP.FIRE_NAME, CII.ORG_DATA =TEMP.ORG_DATA,CII.ERR_MSG = TEMP.ERR_MSG, CII.STATUS =TEMP.STATUS,CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.CREATE_USER =TEMP.CREATE_USER,CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE =TEMP.DEPT_CODE,CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.WORKFLOW_ID = TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID,CII.UPDATE_TIME = NOW()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DATAUUID,DATAID, INTERF_TYPE, FIRE_NAME, ORG_DATA,ERR_MSG, STATUS, UPDATE_USER, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME, WORKFLOW_ID, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_DEPT) VALUES(TEMP.DATAUUID,TEMP.DATAID, TEMP.INTERF_TYPE, TEMP.FIRE_NAME, TEMP.ORG_DATA,TEMP.ERR_MSG, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT)
